Questions

Straight answers, before you ask.

Do I have to write anything?

No. You talk, we write. One interview gives us your knowledge and your voice. You review and approve. That is your whole job.

Will it sound like me?

That’s the first test. You approve a sample chapter in your voice before the full book is written.

How fast is 5 to 8 working days, really?

From your approved outline. Writing, editing, cover and formatting run as one production line.

Who owns the book?

You do. 100% of the rights, royalties and the publishing account stay in your name.

How does payment work?

50% to start (non-refundable once work begins), final 50% only when you approve the finished book.

Do you guarantee sales or bestseller status?

No. Be careful with anyone who does. We guarantee the book: researched, in your voice, professionally published, approved by you.

Your competitors are still “planning to write one.”

5 to 8 working days from approved outline to a publish-ready book with your name on it.
